title: On the Limits of Machine-Learned Ranking for Modern Microarchitectural Policies
abstract: arXiv:2608.01041v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine-learning predictors estimate processor performance far faster than cycle-level simulation. For design-space exploration, however, the valuable test is not merely reproducing the usual hardware ordering, but identifying how different hardware configurations rank on individual program phases. We evaluate four ML-predictors in two design regimes: \emph{Structural Parameters} (SP), varying hardware resources such as issue width, ROB size, and cache capacity; and \emph{Behavioral Policies} (BP), varying prefetching and replacement algorithms. In the SP regime, aggregate ranking is strong, yet counter-intuitive windows(CIW)---where the configuration expected to be slower is faster---constitute $22.4\%$ of non-tied windows across five pairs with a clear architectural prior. translated_title: 论机器学习排序在现代微架构策略中的局限性
translated_abstract: 机器学习预测器估计处理器性能的速度远快于周期级仿真。然而，对于设计空间探索而言，有价值的测试不仅仅是复现通常的硬件排序，而是识别不同硬件配置在各个程序阶段上的排序表现。我们在两种设计模式下评估了四个机器学习预测器：结构参数（SP）模式，即改变发射宽度、ROB大小和缓存容量等硬件资源；以及行为策略（BP）模式，即改变预取和替换算法。在SP模式下，总体排序表现强劲，然而反直觉窗口（CIW）——即预期较慢的配置反而更快的情形——在具有明确架构先验的五个配置对中占非平局窗口的22.4%。这些配置对之间CIW的匹配率仅为23.3%至39.9%；每个点估计均低于50%的随机严格排序参考值。BP模式则呈现出……
tldr: 该研究评估了四个机器学习性能预测器在结构参数与行为策略两种设计模式下的排序能力，发现尽管总体排序表现良好，但反直觉窗口普遍存在且跨配置对匹配率低于随机水平，揭示了机器学习排序在现代微架构策略设计探索中的局限性。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates four ML performance predictors across structural parameter and behavioral policy design regimes, revealing that despite strong aggregate ranking, counter-intuitive windows are prevalent with cross-pair match rates below random baselines, exposing the limits of machine-learned ranking for modern microarchitectural policy design-space exploration.
